facts.fact: The Code des personnes et de la famille (text of the ALT's commission, August 2025) provides that civil-status acts are entered in each centre on registers kept in duplicate, immediately on both (arts. 142-11 and 143-3), on physical registers numbered and initialled by the court (art. 142-13); the text carries no adoption date, so the date is the document's.

The same code institutes a national digital civil-status register and provides that a centre which is computerised and connected to it may keep its registers in a single copy, with transcriptions and marginal mentions also entered in the national register (arts. 142-11 and 143-12); how the register works is left to a decree, and the text does not say that any centre is connected; the date is the document's.
